answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 38135 Country: India Title: Masla of Tayammum Question: Does the tayammum also breaks the same way as wuzu breaks or it doesn't? Answer ID: 38135 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 712/784/B=1433) Yes, the things break wudhu, they break tayammum too. Moreover, tayammum breaks if one becomes able to use water. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
